user_decision.label: Fixed reliability rail inside the captured Placement Affordance

surface.placement: one fixed two-line reliability rail below the retained source/type/destination summary and above one fixed action row inside the captured target-column Placement Affordance
surface.geometry: reserve rail and action-row geometry before Confirm; never expand the target column or clip controls
prohibited: toast, dialog, global alert, detached panel, or adjacent-surface fallback
optimistic source removal or result insertion
prototype or existing-product reliability realization as authority
theme-ID product behavior or copy branch

pending.focus: retain the rendered unavailable Confirm control
pending.effect: retain and lock source, candidate, summary, affordance, and conflicting interactions; show no optimistic result

unknown.copy: We couldn’t confirm whether “{title}” was placed.
unknown.effect: retain the same operation ID and start no mutation

reconciling.focus: retain the unavailable Check again action position
reconciling.effect: read complete authoritative pre/postconditions with the same operation ID; repeated activation is suppressed

not_applied.copy: “{title}” wasn’t placed. Your source is unchanged.
not_applied.effect: Retry alone reuses the logical operation and preallocated result ID; Cancel closes without a write

stale_source.copy: The source changed. Nothing was placed. Cancel and drag it again.
stale_source.effect: apply latest source authority; never restore or place from the stale snapshot

stale_target.copy: The destination changed. Nothing was placed. Cancel and drag to the current destination.
stale_target.effect: apply latest Grid authority; never correct, substitute, or reuse the stale target

success.focus: actual authoritative Node or Bit card
success.effect: announce once, remove the affordance without a timer or decorative result, render the actual card, and leave Newly Placed/Undo appearance to DP-VQ10

focus_and_cancel.pending_and_reconciling: contain focus in the active affordance; visible Confirm/Cancel or Check again remains at its fixed position but unavailable; Escape is locked
focus_and_cancel.terminal_non_success: Cancel or Escape returns to the surviving Breakdown grip or staged candidate surface, otherwise the owning Breakdown or Staging heading
focus_and_cancel.copy_change: status changes never steal focus by themselves

authoritative_result_mapping.rejected_or_conflict: classify as stale source or stale target from returned authoritative facts; never create a generic fallback state or guess which side changed
authoritative_result_mapping.unknown: not authoritative; retain operation identity and offer read-only Check again

lifetime_and_accessibility.pending: Confirm until authoritative result or unknown outcome
lifetime_and_accessibility.reconciling: until authoritative result or another unknown outcome
lifetime_and_accessibility.accessibility: one visible polite atomic rail, one announcement per changed sentence, and text plus a static non-color state mark

motion.ordinary: rail/action replacement, affordance removal, actual-card insertion, and focus handoff are immediate and static
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, skeleton, shimmer, spinner, progress loop, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, focus, timing, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: restrained technical status rail with canonical semantic border, text, action, and focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: narrow pinned status slip beneath the retained placement summary
theme_mapping.neumorphism: shallow inset status trough inside the existing shadow family
theme_mapping.claymorphism: compact sculpted status ribbon whose static shape carries state without motion
theme_mapping.origami: seam-attached status strip with a fixed paper edge and no animated fold
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven one-line [SYS] status record with text/non-color cue and no blink
theme_mapping.retro-mac: in-pane 1-bit system line with hard action controls and no new window or dialog
theme_mapping.graphite: strengthened-rule status caption with restrained monochrome action and precise focus outline

implementation_boundary.excludes: product implementation in Task 115, VQ-09 and Task 116, DP-VQ10 Newly/Undo appearance, command/repository changes, prototype or existing-product reliability authority, adjacent fallback, and theme-ID logic

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 115 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
exact_release.all_other_tasks: unreleased; Task 116 and every later decision remain unstarted
